payload.scientific_problem: The first prospectively locked anchored-replacement panel produced three IVG-level single-call JAK2 scores, including -11.1, under known approximately 0.5 single-call variability. Determine whether the signal persists across fresh docking seeds.
payload.primary_output: A complete three-candidate by three-fresh-seed score grid and per-candidate mean docking score.
payload.validation_setting: Post-selection confirmation on the answer-known JAK2 seed-1 delta-0.6 development cell; not a fresh candidate evaluation and not a benchmark-wide result.
payload.authorization: The user approved aggressive continued JAK2 route-distilled plus FiberControl development, Modal execution, and obtaining a quick reliable answer. This contract narrows that authority to nine fixed confirmation calls.
payload.selection_rule: The three endpoints at or better than the published IVG mean in the immutable first-pass result, selected once before any fresh-seed confirmation score exists.
payload.promotion_rule: Pass if at least one candidate succeeds on all three fresh seeds and its fresh-seed mean is at or below -10.4.
payload.failure_rule: If no complete candidate mean reaches -10.4, retain the single-call pilot as a positive proposal-support result but do not quote an IVG-level replicated score.
prohibitions: no retry of failed physical calls
no use of confirmation results to rewrite the first-pass result
no held-out or benchmark-wide IVG claim
